name: Card profile
description: "Structure it" and "Fill empty" for the Profile tab, three drafts for a new persona, and the group editor's scene generation: one model call proposes profile fields, a group's shared scenario or one of its openings, filed as a draft the user accepts or discards. Nothing on a card or a group changes here. Drafts live in data/profile-drafts/ (<characterId>.json, persona-<id>.json, group-<groupId>.json).
